fichas.title: Briefing questionnaire
fichas.summary: A work-saving briefing form for collecting project information before design begins. It prompts the architect to establish the client’s circumstances and preferences, fee agreements, project participants and procedures, site logistics, construction requirements, and basic design factors. The page also emphasizes that adequate preparation and better-organized work help address rushed projects and incomplete documents.
uses: Collect and organize project information at commissioning
Clarify client authority, preferences, and project expectations
Identify project participants, responsibilities, and procedures
Review site logistics, construction requirements, and design constraints
